title: Fields, not cells: code, derived data and fovplan
description: Analysis code, derived per-field data and the fovplan planning tool for the manuscript 'Fields, not cells, determine precision and replication in spatial cell-composition studies'. Version 1.0.1 adds fovplan 0.2.0 (bisection search), a worked tutorial, the mixed-model and differential-abundance comparison with its R reference-package re-analysis, the planner benchmark and the design-choice analyses (field selection, precision target and pilot size, field size, annotation error).
